MIRACL_2019-08-21-asm32_gcc13_x86_libmir.notes: The configuration of the sample this was requested for is not known. The tracker issue asks for a comparison against LockBit 3.0's keygen.exe (32-bit), and the evidence that its keygen uses MIRACL at all is by name; no verified sample, mirdef.h, word size, assembly setting or curve is available. MIRACL's mirdef.h selects the word size, whether muldiv/muldvd/muldvm are assembly, and which arithmetic paths the library compiles in, and that changes the code shape a great deal, so these variants are built side by side instead of one being guessed. Which of them, if any, matches that keygen is unknown. This is the ELF build of the 'asm32' variant (32-bit with the assembly muldiv upstream's own script uses) of upstream commit b9b8fd471de253cfd6313446cb490741edb069a7.
